status: exploratory mechanistic diagnostic performed after heat-rank discovery controls; not prospective validation
method: ordinary least-squares projection onto an intercept and single-nucleotide or single-codon indicator functions, fitted separately in each compatibility component
rank_restoration: reassign the observed component score multiset in fitted-score order; average99 independent random orders for numerical ties at1e-10 times max(1,fitted range)
purpose: test whether simple additive score organization is sufficient to produce similarly low extra fragmentation on the exact graph
not_a_predictive_test: scores used to fit and assess the approximation are the same; R_squared is in-sample, saturated fits and residual degrees of freedom are reported
not_a_conditional_null: the fitted additive surrogate need not match every local correlation or epistatic pattern; it is a descriptive approximation
discovery_consequence: similarly low or lower fragmentation under additive surrogates rules out interpreting the permutation contrast alone as an RNA-specific preservation mechanism
constrained_geometry: even a generic additive score can create barriers when positive alleles conflict under pairing/coding constraints; compatibility geometry matters independently of folding-specific interactions
